name: 5 shots on the beep (par 5.0s)
notes: Random delay, beep, 5 shots. Striker pistol: splits include rack time.

name: 5-dot sequence (par 8s)
notes: Each shot must hit the next dot in order.

name: Clay trio, shotgun (par 4s)
notes: Shotgun mode forced on; uses the target's spread.

name: Hostage: 2 head shots (par 3s)
notes: Two in the head box (10 each); hostage hit = -10.

name: Familiarization course (8 stages)
notes: Time + points down. Swap the printed target before each stage; the app checks the target ID. Score = raw time + PD x1s + PE x3s + HNT x5s. Lower is better.

stages.name: 1. Warm-up (practice face)
stages.brief: 3 shots to the dark body -0 circle. Learn the zones.

stages.name: 2. Basic threat
stages.brief: From the beep: 2 to the body -0.

stages.name: 3. Head shots
stages.brief: 2 to the head -0 circle; rest of the head box is -1.

stages.name: 4. Hard cover: left
stages.brief: Left half is behind hard cover. 2 on the exposed -0.

stages.name: 5. Hard cover: lower
stages.brief: Lower body covered. 2 on the upper -0 or head.

stages.name: 6. Hard cover: diagonal
stages.brief: Diagonal cover. 2 on the exposed -0 edge.

stages.name: 7. Threat + non-threat
stages.brief: 2 on the RIGHT threat only. Hands = non-threat (+5 s).

stages.name: 8. Multiple threats
stages.brief: 2 each on T1, T2, T3 in order. Out of order = PE.

name: Random calls (letter landscape)
notes: Targets are called in random order (spoken + shown). Shoot only the called threats with the required shots; T5 Mozambique = 2 body then 1 head. T6 / front of T8 are non-threats (+5 s). Wrong order or Mozambique part = PE +3 s. Each PD = +1 s, miss = 5 PD.

name: Random calls (tabloid 11x17)
notes: Targets are called in random order (spoken + shown). Shoot only the called threats with the required shots; T5 Mozambique = 2 body then 1 head. T6 / front of T8 are non-threats (+5 s). Wrong order or Mozambique part = PE +3 s. Each PD = +1 s, miss = 5 PD.

name: Shoot / don't-shoot: threat vs compliant (tabloid 11x17)
notes: At the beep 4 targets are called: 'GUN' = threat, shoot it 2x; 'HANDS UP' = compliant: do NOT shoot, give a verbal command ('Drop it!', 'Show me your hands!', 'Police, don't move!') within 3 s. Each hit on a compliant target = +5 s; each compliant target without a command in time = +3 s. Mic must be on. Only command phrases are heard while live.

name: Shoot / don't-shoot: threat vs compliant (letter landscape)
notes: At the beep 4 targets are called: 'GUN' = threat, shoot it 2x; 'HANDS UP' = compliant: do NOT shoot, give a verbal command ('Drop it!', 'Show me your hands!', 'Police, don't move!') within 3 s. Each hit on a compliant target = +5 s; each compliant target without a command in time = +3 s. Mic must be on. Only command phrases are heard while live.

name: Crowd Hunt L1 (one attribute)
notes: Description is spoken and shown. Each call matches exactly one person. 2 shots per call, 3 random rounds. Wrong person +5 s, bystander +10 s (backstop failure).

name: Crowd Hunt L2 (two attributes)
notes: Description is spoken and shown. Each call matches exactly one person. 2 shots per call, 3 random rounds. Wrong person +5 s, bystander +10 s (backstop failure).

name: Crowd Hunt L3 (three+ / relative position)
notes: Description is spoken and shown. Each call matches exactly one person. 2 shots per call, 3 random rounds. Wrong person +5 s, bystander +10 s (backstop failure).

name: Sink-the-Ship: sink the fleet
notes: Random hidden fleet. Fewest shots wins.

name: Sink-the-Ship: timed (3 min)
notes: Sink as much as you can in 3 minutes.

name: Maritime: easy (named target)
notes: The app names the boat. Aim at the engines.

name: Maritime: medium (by type)
notes: The app calls a craft type. Civilians -20.

name: Maritime: decision (smuggler or civilian?)
notes: Some fast boats are civilian (no cargo). Only engage boats with bales/drums or the semi-sub.

name: Maritime: easy (named target) (Tabloid)
notes: The app names the boat. Aim at the engines.

name: Maritime: medium (by type) (Tabloid)
notes: The app calls a craft type. Civilians -20.

name: Maritime: decision (smuggler or civilian?) (Tabloid)
notes: Some fast boats are civilian (no cargo). Only engage boats with bales/drums or the semi-sub.

name: Friend or Foe: sides

calls.say: friendlies blue and yellow. Engage white tape
friendlies white. Engage blue and yellow tape

notes: The app assigns the friendly side each round. Fratricide -25.

name: Friend or Foe: single tape
notes: Engage one tape colour only; all others are friendly. Fratricide -25.

name: Friend or Foe: counter-drone
notes: The app calls a drone type (FPV, Mavic, hexacopter, Shahed); hit it. Smaller drone = more points. Soldier hits count as wrong (-2).

name: Friend or Foe: sides (Tabloid)

calls.say: friendlies blue and yellow. Engage white tape
friendlies white. Engage blue and yellow tape

notes: The app assigns the friendly side each round. Fratricide -25.

name: Friend or Foe: single tape (Tabloid)
notes: Engage one tape colour only; all others are friendly. Fratricide -25.

name: Friend or Foe: counter-drone (Tabloid)
notes: The app calls a drone type (FPV, Mavic, hexacopter, Shahed); hit it. Smaller drone = more points. Soldier hits count as wrong (-2).

name: Die Hard: Hans Mozambique
notes: Hans draws the P7. 2 chest -0 then 1 head -0. Wrong part order = PE +3 s.

name: Die Hard: Stairwell (Karl)
notes: Karl coming up the stairs. 2 on the exposed chest/head; the black rail is hard cover.

name: Die Hard: 31st floor (Tony)
notes: Tony through the door. 2 to the chest -0.

name: Die Hard: Lobby desk (Franco)
notes: Franco behind the desk with an AUG. 2 on exposed upper body; desk = hard cover.

name: Die Hard: Pillar (Heinrich)
notes: Heinrich half behind a pillar. 2 on the exposed side.

name: Die Hard: The guard (Eddie) shoot/don't-shoot
notes: Called GUN: 2 to the chest. Called HANDS UP: do not shoot, say "Drop it!" / "Show me your hands!" within 3 s.

name: Die Hard: Vault tech (Theo) shoot/don't-shoot
notes: Mostly compliant. HANDS UP: verbal command within 3 s. GUN: 2 to the chest.

name: Die Hard: "Bill Clay" impostor
notes: The leader posing as a hostage. HANDS UP: "Get down!" within 3 s. GUN: 3 shots (2 chest + head).

name: Die Hard: Roof Finale
notes: Exactly 2 shots: Hans exposed center mass -0, then Eddie head -0. Any hit on Holly = +5 s and stage FAIL.

name: Die Hard: Christmas party
notes: 2 on Tony only. The hatched guest is a hostage: +5 s per hit.

name: Die Hard: Lobby (Uli)
notes: Uli with the AUG. 2 to the chest -0.

name: Die Hard: Friendly ID (Sgt. Powell)
notes: Hold fire: the officer is FRIENDLY. Say "Police! Friendly!". Clean run = 4.00 s hold. Any hit = friendly fire +10 s and FAIL (the run ends on the shot).

name: Die Hard: Lobby, Powell arrives
notes: 2 on Uli only. Sgt. Powell is FRIENDLY: hit = +10 s and FAIL.

name: Die Hard: Nakatomi random calls (tabloid)
notes: Names are spoken in random order: Hans = 1 head shot, others 2 chest. Theo (T6) and Bill Clay (T7) are not called (PE if hit). Sgt. Powell is FRIENDLY: +10 s and FAIL.

name: Die Hard: Nakatomi shoot/don't-shoot (tabloid)
notes: 4 crew are called: GUN = 2 shots, HANDS UP = verbal command within 3 s ("Drop it!", "Show me your hands!"). Hit on compliant = +5 s, late command = +3 s.

name: Die Hard: Nakatomi Plaza story course (7 stages)
notes: Swap sheets between stages. Score = time + PD + PE x3 + hostage hits x5, summed.

stages.name: 6. Roof finale: Hans, Holly, Eddie
stages.brief: Hans center mass, then Eddie head. Do not hit Holly.

name: Carnival Shoot: free fire (60 s)
notes: Shoot anything: pig 3, duck 2, bullseye blue 5 / white 3; red ring scores 0.

name: Carnival Shoot: called shots
notes: The app calls an item ("duck 3", "bullseye 5", "all pigs", "small duck"); hit it to get the next call. Wrong item -2.

name: Hostage: 2 center mass (par 3s)
notes: Two to the threat's exposed center mass (X/10/9); the hostage covers his right side. Hostage hit = -10.

name: Ankle Draw L1: Standing
notes: Standing start, say "start". Beep: ankle draw, drop to a kneel, 2 to the called threat. Par 4.0s. Shoppers = -10.

name: Ankle Draw L2: Seated
notes: Seated start, say "start". Beep: ankle draw, drop to a kneel, 2 to the called threat. Par 3.5s. Shoppers = -10.

name: Ankle Draw L3: Walking
notes: Walking start, say "start". Beep: ankle draw, drop to a kneel, 2 to the called threat. Par 3.0s. Shoppers = -10.

name: Ankle Draw L4: Random start
notes: Random start start, say "start". Beep: ankle draw, drop to a kneel, the app calls one threat: 1 head shot. Par 2.5s. Shoppers = -10.

name: Ankle Draw: all threats
notes: Random start position. Kneel, 2 to every threat in the called order. Shoppers = -10.

name: Ankle Draw L1: Standing (Tabloid)
notes: Standing start, say "start". Beep: ankle draw, drop to a kneel, 2 to the called threat. Par 4.0s. Shoppers = -10.

name: Ankle Draw L2: Seated (Tabloid)
notes: Seated start, say "start". Beep: ankle draw, drop to a kneel, 2 to the called threat. Par 3.5s. Shoppers = -10.

name: Ankle Draw L3: Walking (Tabloid)

name: Ankle Draw L4: Random start (Tabloid)
notes: Random start start, say "start". Beep: ankle draw, drop to a kneel, the app calls one threat: 1 head shot. Par 2.5s. Shoppers = -10.

name: Ankle Draw: all threats (Tabloid)
notes: Random start position. Kneel, 2 to every threat in the called order. Shoppers = -10.

name: Card Shoot: poker hand
notes: Shoot five different cards; score = hand rank x10 (royal flush 90).

name: Card Shoot: call-out
notes: Hit the called card ("queen of hearts", "any club").

notes: Shoot five different cards; score = hand rank x10 (royal flush 90).

notes: Hit the called card ("queen of hearts", "any club").

name: Counter-Terror: vest!
notes: Head-only on the vest wearer. Body hit = vest strike.

name: Counter-Terror: clear the street
notes: Every militant, then the vest wearer (head only).
